props.name: prefixIcon
props.description: Set on AlertItem.Link. If true, the 'chevron-left' icon will be displayed before the link text. If a string, that string will be used as the icon name.

props.name: suffixIcon
props.description: Set on AlertItem.Link. If true, the 'arrow-to-top-right' icon will be displayed before the link text. If a string, that string will be used as the icon name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Set on AlertItem.Link. If true, the link will be disabled and not clickable. The default value is false.

props.name: noHoverUnderline
props.description: Set on AlertItem.Link. If true, the underline on hover will be disabled. The default value is false.
